"""Task-local approved Lane B candidate: canonical extraction, real SQL, live Codex provider.

Foreground replies/policy are controlled intake fixtures. No hosted app state,
running service or model prompt is changed. All paid sends cross the owned proxy.
"""
import asyncio
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace
from uuid import uuid4

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / 'tests')]
import httpx
import pytest
import uvicorn
from dotenv import dotenv_values
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response
from scripts.controlled_lifecycle import new_native_root, reconcile_native_directory, sigterm_cancellable
from scripts.evaluation_budget import BudgetedProvider, BudgetLimits
from scripts.canonical_turn import canonical_turn
from test_agent_commit_postgres import database, OWNER
from test_shared_memory_events_postgres import rpc, literal
from test_lifetime_composer_capacity import service
from memoir_postgres_workflow import PostgresRest
from controlled_policy import install_policy_review_transport
from apps.api.codex_runtime import CodexRuntime
from apps.api.lifetime_memory_composer import _extract
from apps.api.lifetime_memory_lane_engine import BoundedLaneInput, LanePublication, run_bounded_lane, lane_contract

config = dotenv_values(ROOT / '.env', interpolate=False)
key = config['MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_API_KEY']
endpoint = config['MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_BASE_URL'].replace('http://192.168.65.1:4000', 'http://192.168.65.27:4000').rstrip('/')
relay_container = 'llm-provider-litellm-1'
model = config.get('MEMORY_SPARK_MEMOIR_COMPOSER_MODEL') or config['MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_MODEL']
effort = config.get('MEMORY_SPARK_AUTHOR_TIMELINE_REASONING_EFFORT') or 'low'
for name in ('MEMORY_SPARK_CODEX_WORKER_URL', 'MEMORY_SPARK_TASK_DB'):
    os.environ.pop(name, None)
os.environ.update(MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_BASE_URL=endpoint, MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_API_KEY=key,
    MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_MODEL=config['MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_MODEL'], MEMORY_SPARK_MEMOIR_COMPOSER_MODEL=model,
    MEMORY_SPARK_COLLECTOR_PROMPT_VERSION='reply-v2', MEMOIR_TWO_LANES='1',
    MEMOIR_INTERVIEW_STRATEGY='1', MEMORY_SPARK_TEST_MODE='1',
    MEMORY_SPARK_LLM_REASONING_EFFORT=effort, LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENABLED='false')
RUN=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'heldout'
assert RUN.startswith('heldout') and '/' not in RUN
OUTPUT = HERE / (RUN+'-live.json')
assert not OUTPUT.exists(), 'Never overwrite previous model evidence'
cases = [case for case in json.loads((HERE / 'heldout-cases.json').read_text()) if case['id']=='heldout-zh-window']
assert len(cases)==1
report = dict(source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
    skill='memoir-author-timeline', phase='extract', model=model, requested_effort=effort,
    scope='Real SQL and canonical lane dispatcher/checkpoint/extraction; native Codex extraction generations. Foreground intake, profile proposal, and API-to-worker seam are controlled fixtures. No deployed-worker, live-profile or Temporal claim.',
    native_codex=subprocess.check_output(['codex','--version'],text=True,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip(),
    cases_sha256=hashlib.sha256((HERE/'heldout-cases.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    state_reset_per_case=True, gateway_network_address=endpoint, hard_calls=42, per_call_seconds=90, per_case_seconds=300, deadline_seconds=1000,
    provider_transport='task-owned mocker exec relay to the same gateway localhost; no service mutation',
    calls=[], cases=[], source_sha256={}, cleanup={}, active_case=None)
for folder in ('apps/api', 'skills'):
    for p in sorted((ROOT/folder).rglob('*')):
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.py','.md','.json'}:
            report['source_sha256'][str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for relative in ('supabase/migrations/202610180001_initial_schema.sql','scripts/evaluation_budget.py',
                 'scripts/canonical_turn.py','scripts/controlled_lifecycle.py','tests/test_agent_commit_postgres.py',
                 'tests/test_shared_memory_events_postgres.py','tests/test_lifetime_composer_capacity.py',
                 'tests/memoir_postgres_workflow.py','tests/controlled_policy.py','tests/test_derived_evidence_spans.py'):
    report['source_sha256'][relative]=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report['approved_change']='Attribution ambiguity uses existing PAGE_AMBIGUOUS feedback; validators/prompts/schema/model/transport unchanged.'
report['per_run_max_calls']=6
report['source_sha256']['tests/test_extraction_span_repair.py']=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'tests/test_extraction_span_repair.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report['harness_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
started = time.monotonic()
def save():
    body=json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+'\n'
    assert key not in body
    temp=OUTPUT.with_suffix('.tmp');temp.write_text(body);temp.replace(OUTPUT)

app=FastAPI()
@app.post('/v1/responses')
async def responses(request: Request):
    if request.headers.get('authorization')!='Bearer '+key:
        return Response(status_code=403)
    earlier=sum(len(json.loads(p.read_text())['calls']) for p in HERE.glob('*-live.json') if p!=OUTPUT)
    if earlier+len(report['calls'])>=report['hard_calls'] or time.monotonic()-started>report['deadline_seconds']:
        return Response(status_code=429)
    if len(report['calls'])>=6:return Response(status_code=429)
    raw=await request.body()
    if len(raw)>512_000:return Response(status_code=413)
    body=json.loads(raw)
    assert body['model']==model and body.get('stream') is True
    # A finite diagnostic output ceiling, recorded separately from the original body.
    bound=16384
    original=deepcopy(body)
    body['max_output_tokens']=min(body.get('max_output_tokens') or bound,bound)
    row=dict(index=len(report['calls']),case=report['active_case'],original_request=original,
        request=body,started_s=time.monotonic()-started,status='started')
    report['calls'].append(row);save()
    budget=BudgetedProvider(BudgetLimits(1,600_000,bound,bound),max_elapsed_seconds=90)
    async def call(max_output_tokens):
        code='''import json,sys,time,signal,urllib.request,urllib.error
signal.alarm(82)
v=json.load(sys.stdin)
t=time.monotonic()
request=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/responses",data=json.dumps(v["body"]).encode(),headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+v["key"],"Content-Type":"application/json"})
try:r=urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=80)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:r=e
status=r.status
first=None
a=bytearray()
while True:
 b=r.read1(65536)
 if not b:break
 if first is None:first=time.monotonic()-t
 a.extend(b)
 if len(a)>2000000:raise ValueError("Provider response exceeds diagnostic bound")
print(json.dumps({"status":status,"data":a.decode(),"provider_seconds":time.monotonic()-t,"first_provider_byte_seconds":first}))
'''
        process=await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec('mocker','exec','-i',relay_container,'python','-c',code,
            stdin=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE)
        try:
            out,err=await asyncio.wait_for(process.communicate(json.dumps(dict(key=key,body=body)).encode()),85)
        finally:
            if process.returncode is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:await asyncio.wait_for(process.wait(),2)
                except TimeoutError:process.kill();await process.wait()
        if process.returncode:
            row['relay_error']=err.decode(errors='replace')[:1000].replace(key,'[redacted-provider-key]')
            raise RuntimeError('Task-local relay failed')
        result=json.loads(out)
        row.update(http_status=result['status'],provider_seconds=result['provider_seconds'],
            first_provider_byte_seconds=result['first_provider_byte_seconds'])
        if result['status']>=400:
            row['provider_error']=result['data'][:16384].replace(key,'[redacted-provider-key]')
            raise RuntimeError('Gateway response was not successful')
        row['raw_provider_response']=result['data']
        for line in row['raw_provider_response'].splitlines():
            if not line.startswith('data:'):continue
            try:event=json.loads(line[5:])
            except ValueError:continue
            if isinstance(event.get('response'),dict):row['provider_response']=event['response']
        return dict(data=result['data'].encode(),usage=row.get('provider_response',{}).get('usage'))
    try:
        result=await budget.call(call,input_tokens_upper_bound=600_000)
        row['status']='completed'
        return Response(content=result['data'],media_type='text/event-stream')
    except BaseException as error:
        row.update(status='cancelled' if isinstance(error,asyncio.CancelledError) else 'failed',error_type=type(error).__name__)
        if isinstance(error,asyncio.CancelledError):raise
        return Response(status_code=502,content='Bounded diagnostic provider failed')
    finally:
        row['finished_s']=time.monotonic()-started;row['budget']=budget.receipt();save()


@asynccontextmanager
async def proxy():
    sock=socket.socket();sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));sock.listen(16);sock.setblocking(False)
    server=uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(app,log_level='error',access_log=False,log_config=None,lifespan='off'))
    task=asyncio.create_task(server.serve(sockets=[sock]))
    try:
        for _ in range(200):
            if server.started:break
            if task.done():await task
            await asyncio.sleep(.01)
        assert server.started
        yield f'http://127.0.0.1:{sock.getsockname()[1]}/v1'
    finally:
        server.should_exit=True
        await asyncio.wait_for(task,10)
        sock.close()


async def intake(sql,text,language,project=None):
    # The measured skill begins after this controlled, canonical A handoff.
    from apps.api import policy_review
    patches=pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    install_policy_review_transport(patches)
    def reply(request):
        value=dict(acknowledgement=text[-200:],question='What do you remember most about that experience?' if language=='en-AU' else '关于这段经历，您印象最深的是什么？',
            reason='latest_story',hint=None,quote=text[-200:],work=dict(mode='extract',name=None))
        result=dict(thread_id='controlled-intake',reply=json.dumps(value),artifacts=[])
        if request.headers.get('accept')=='application/x-ndjson':
            return httpx.Response(200,headers={'content-type':'application/x-ndjson'},content='\n'.join(json.dumps(event) for event in [dict(type='provider_complete',data=result),dict(type='result',data=result)])+'\n')
        return httpx.Response(200,json=result)
    storage=PostgresRest(sql,OWNER).storage()
    runtime=CodexRuntime(home_root=HERE/'intake-homes',worker_url='http://controlled.invalid',worker_secret='synthetic',worker_transport=httpx.MockTransport(reply))
    try:
        result=await canonical_turn(runtime,storage,text,options=dict(language=language,client_turn_id=str(uuid4()),project_id=project))
        return result['project_id']
    finally:
        storage.client.close();patches.undo()


@sigterm_cancellable
async def run(sql):
    from apps.api.lifetime_memory_composer import execute_lifetime_lane
    os.environ['MEMOIR_PUBLICATION_DATABASE_URL']=sql.publication_dsn
    sql('update public.lifetime_two_lane_rollout set enabled=true,strategy_enabled=true,strategy_shadow=false;')
    class Broker:
        async def rpc(self,name,**args):
            query=','.join(k+'=>'+literal(v) for k,v in args.items())
            result=await asyncio.to_thread(sql,"set role service_role;select coalesce(to_jsonb(public."+name+"("+query+")),'null'::jsonb);")
            return json.loads(result.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
    publisher=LanePublication(sql.publication_dsn,authenticated_owner=OWNER)
    async with proxy() as url:
        for case in cases:
            row=dict(id=case['id'],input=case['text'],prior_input=case.get('prior_text'),language=case['language'],quality=case['quality'],started_s=time.monotonic()-started,phases=[],outcomes=[])
            report['cases'].append(row);report['active_case']=case['id'];save()
            try:
                sql('truncate public.user_memoir_project cascade; truncate public.user_memory,public.user_agent_turn_lease,public.user_recall_usage cascade;')
                sql("update public.user_profile set profile='{}'; update auth.users set is_anonymous=false;")
                async def worker(request):
                    wire=json.loads(request.content)
                    bounded=BoundedLaneInput.model_validate(wire['bounded_lane'])
                    phase=dict(phase=bounded.phase,fence=bounded.fence.model_dump(mode='json'),packet=bounded.packet,started_s=time.monotonic()-started)
                    row['phases'].append(phase);save()
                    if bounded.phase=='profile':
                        phase.update(controlled_fixture=True,status='completed',finished_s=time.monotonic()-started)
                        save()
